title: EnrichResponse
description: POST /v1.0/enrich response: the scores and observations projection, plus the processor version and a generation timestamp.

processorVersion.description: Version of the @rtcstats/rtcstats-processor package that produced the analysis (semver, e.g. 1.9.0).

generatedAt.description: Unix epoch time in milliseconds when the response was generated.

EnrichData.description: Scores, per-severity observation counts, trimmed observations, and user-agent data. No stored-session fields.

observations.description: Flat, SQL-friendly observation records. Absent or non-finite values are omitted, never null.

userAgentData.description: Browser, platform, hardware and screen information. Empty object when the dump carries none.

Observation.description: A single trimmed observation: flat and SQL-friendly. Only type and severity are always present; every other field is included only when it has a finite value, never as null.

type.description: Observation type key, e.g. 'turnNoConfig'. The full catalog is available from GET /v1.0/observations.

tags.description: Tags attached to the observation (e.g. network, audio, video, connectivity, security).

firstSeenAt.description: Epoch timestamp (ms) of the first occurrence, truncated to a whole millisecond. Omitted when unknown or non-finite.

url.description: Related URL when applicable (e.g. the TURN server URL).

property.description: The specific property the observation refers to (e.g. audioLevel).

valueInCount.description: Observation value as a count (e.g. number of duplicated lines or occurrences).

valueInPercent.description: Observation value as a percentage (e.g. audio/video loss, frames dropped).

averageInMs.description: Average value in milliseconds (e.g. jitter, rtt, encode/decode time).

durationInMs.description: Duration in milliseconds (e.g. TURN/STUN delay, signaling time).

durationInPercent.description: Duration of the observation as a percentage of the call.

ObservationsCount.description: Observation counts grouped by severity. The five values sum to the length of the observations array.

Scores.description: The five scores produced by the analyzer. Each is a number or null.

experienceScore.description: Overall experience score (0-100). Null when there is no media data to score against.

audioScore.description: Audio quality score (1-5). Null when no audio stream is present.

videoScore.description: Video quality score (1-5). Null when no video stream is present.

connectivityScore.description: Connectivity score (1-5). Null when no peer connection produced a connectivity score.

observationsScore.description: Aggregated severity score derived from observations. Null when unavailable.
